# Actual surface entropy pays the discounted parity-repair error

This is an exact bridge between the same-separator surface entropy and
quantified-projective-surface-repair-and-concavity-dissipation-rate-geometry.md.
It constructs the required old paired law from the actual physical
surface martingale. It does not identify the surface and volume rows,
and does not turn a nonnegative one-sided response cost into zero.

The useful version concerns a PRESCRIBED paired branch whose two actual
endpoint marginals can differ. The symmetric self-pairing constructed
in Sections 1-2 is only a feasibility check: its diagonal competitor
makes the numerical repair trivial, as proved in Section 8 below.

## 1. Normal-preserving physical martingale and a canonical paired law

Use a finite lattice-complete compatible positive-fiber family, its
canonical convex hull C, and the actual surface normal bundle. Let
nu and eta be finite surface measures of the same mass m, and suppose

    Pi(ds,dt,du)=nu(ds,du) P_(s,u)(dt)

is a physical martingale preserving the normal u. Thus its target
marginal is eta, its source and target points lie on their actual
support faces for u, and E[t|s,u]=s. Here s,t include both integer
base and continuous coordinates.

For r in Z^n/2Z^n let p_r(s,u) be the P_(s,u) probability of target
base parity r. If p_r>0 let P_(s,u,r) be the normalized restriction.
The measure

    Tau(ds,du,r,dt_-,dt_+)
      =nu(ds,du) p_r(s,u)
                    P_(s,u,r)(dt_-) P_(s,u,r)(dt_+)         (1)

summed over r is a finite Borel law of mass m. Terms with p_r=0 are
zero and need no chosen conditional probability. Both endpoint
marginals are eta. Both endpoints have the same normal and parity,
so their midpoint b is mixed-integer. Moreover

    E[b|s,u]=sum_r p_r E[t|s,u,r]=s.                       (2)

At a fixed source-and-parity mark, its mean need not be s; the weighted
sum in (2) is the asserted equality. This distinction matters during
marked reconstruction.

## 2. The paired midpoints stay on the actual support graph

Fix a normal u at which the original martingale laws are defined.
Let h_z be the actual support heights and h_tilde=min_j B_j the finite
concave PL support roof agreeing at all sampled bases. Fix a source
s=(z_s,x_s). Since its actual support face has u dot x_s=h_tilde(z_s),
and every target t=(z_t,x_t) has u dot x_t=h_tilde(z_t), the martingale
property gives

    E[h_tilde(z_t)|s,u]=h_tilde(z_s).

Choose any active roof plane B_j(z_s)=h_tilde(z_s). Its nonnegative
target gap has expectation

    E[B_j(z_t)-h_tilde(z_t)|s,u]
        =B_j(z_s)-h_tilde(z_s)=0.

Hence the whole target row lies almost surely in the closed convex
contact cell {B_j=h_tilde}. Any two such target points have midpoint
base p in that cell, and

    u dot (x_-+x_+)/2
       =[h_tilde(z_-)+h_tilde(z_+)]/2=h_tilde(p).

For equal parity, p is integer and belongs to the lattice-complete
base set. Compatibility puts the midpoint in K_p. The equality shows
that it is in the ACTUAL support face K_p(u). Thus the paired law (1)
satisfies the support-graph hypothesis of the repair theorem.

This proof uses only the original normal-preserving martingale and
its actual support graph. It does not presume source-by-source
integer barycenters after parity conditioning.

## 3. Entropy splits into two exact nonnegative gaps

For the rest of this note Tau may be any prescribed ACTUAL marked
paired law, not necessarily the symmetric law (1). Assume it has source
marginal nu and conditional midpoint mean s at source (s,u). Let its
two endpoint marginals be gamma_- and gamma_+, and put

    eta=(gamma_-+gamma_+)/2.

Assume endpoints preserve the source normal and have the same parity
within every pair. Their average is a physical martingale target law
from nu. The argument in Section 2 applies to its average target row:
the nonnegative roof-plane gap of that average has zero integral, hence
each endpoint row lies in the same source contact cell. Thus the actual
support-graph conclusion still holds. Distinct directional or cap
endpoint labels must be retained when specifying gamma_- and gamma_+;
they cannot be replaced by their average before applying the repair.

Let L=min_i A_i>0 on C be the common finite-PL concave denominator.
Its logarithm is finite continuous and concave. Write rho_old=b_#Tau.
By (2) and Jensen,

    S_0:=integral log L dnu-integral log L drho_old>=0.

The paired endpoint Jensen gap is

    Delta_old:=integral [log L(b)
                  -(log L(t_-)+log L(t_+))/2] dTau
              =integral log L drho_old-integral log L deta>=0.

Thus the actual surface entropy has the EXACT decomposition

    S:=integral log L(dnu-deta)=S_0+Delta_old.             (3)

In particular Delta_old<=S. Neither quantity is a volume entropy;
all three laws here are actual surface laws.

## 4. Conditional capacity assumption and the repaired flow

Suppose, in addition, that BOTH prescribed endpoint marginals gamma_-
and gamma_+ are dominated by a common projective surface capacity

    omega=(H_+/L^d) eta_surface,

where H is common concave on the physical convex domain, possibly
normal-dependent, and the bounded Borel weight assumptions of the
repair theorem hold. This domination is a SEPARATE explicit
applicability hypothesis. It does not follow merely from existence
of the physical martingale or the entropy identity (3).

One cannot silently take omega=eta for distinct full endpoint laws.
If (gamma_-+gamma_+)/2=eta and both gamma_-,gamma_+<=eta, their two
nonnegative deficits from eta sum to zero, so gamma_-=gamma_+=eta.
Genuinely distinct endpoint laws therefore require a different or
larger capacity, or an explicitly separated proper subflow.

Apply discounted repair within each normal and original endpoint
parity to the prescribed paired law Tau. Reconstruct its source mark using the
old-to-new midpoint martingale. This retains the joint source,
normal, and parity law and the conditional midpoint mean for each
such mark. Averaging the preserved conditional means over parity
and using (2) gives a new actual physical martingale from nu to the
new midpoint law rho.

The two new endpoint marginals remain gamma_- and gamma_+ separately,
and remain fixed for every normal/parity. Their average remains eta.
They need not remain fixed at each source
mark. Consequently their total pair entropy is

    Delta_new=integral log L drho-integral log L deta,
    0<=Delta_new<=Delta_old<=S.                           (4)

The first inequality is pointwise midpoint Jensen. The second is
convex order within normal/parity, tested with the finite global
convex extension of -log L. No sourcewise comparison of old and new
pair entropy is inferred.

The repair gives an exact discounted law and exact error E:

    rho=D+E,
    D<=2^n omega,
    E=b_#[(1-a^d)Tau_new],
    a=[L(t_-)+L(t_+)]/[2L(b)].                            (5)

Its mass satisfies, for m>0,

    E(total)<=m[1-exp(-d Delta_new/m)]
             <=m[1-exp(-d Delta_old/m)]
             <=m[1-exp(-d S/m)].                         (6)

The first bound follows from the exact discount and Jensen. The
second and third are monotonicity. Hence

    D(total)>=m exp(-d S/m).                             (7)

The same formulas hold before summing normals and parities, with
their respective masses and pair entropies; the fullsource upper
bound S is justified by the total decomposition (3). A sourcewise
budget is not claimed after reconstruction.

There is also an exact decomposition after repair:

    S=[integral log L dnu-integral log L drho]+Delta_new. (8)

The bracket is nonnegative because the reconstructed source-to-new
midpoint law is a martingale. Thus entropy spent on the endpoint
pair gap and entropy retained in source-to-midpoint dispersion add
to the fixed actual surface entropy S.

## 5. Same-separator normalization and the sign of the response

In candidate 0a0ac9e7c499601f,
write the physical density as Xi, its actual surface marginals as

    nu=Xi_+ eta_surface,
    eta=Xi_- eta_surface,
    m=nu(total)=eta(total).

This uses the normal-preserving version of the physical martingale;
an unconditioned martingale alone does not justify the normal repair.
The separator normalization in that source is

    N=d+1,
    Delta_sep=sum_proper eta_i delta_i>0,
    kappa=Delta_sep/(N M_volume).

Its logarithmic physical field is B=-kappa log L. Since
Xi eta_surface=nu-eta, its reserve is exactly

    R=-integral Xi B deta_surface
      =kappa integral log L(dnu-deta)=kappa S.             (9)

Consequently (6), when its additional capacity hypothesis holds,
reads

    E(total)<=m[1-exp(-d R/(kappa m))].                   (10)

Here m is a SURFACE-flow mass and M_volume is the mixed VOLUME mass.
They are not interchangeable. The positive coefficient kappa may
tend to zero in a sequence, and R alone then does not control S;
the ratio R/kappa is the exact entropy in (10).

The actual simultaneous power-flattening response from the same
source is

    R_joint=-(R+Delta_sep K_V/N)<=0,                      (11)

where K_V is its distinct volume relative entropy. Both nonnegative
quantities have the SAME sign in this response. Equations (6)-(10)
show that R can pay a concrete surface-capacity error; they do not
change the sign of (11), force R=0, or compare R with K_V.

## 6. Scaling and capacity multipliers

All mass/entropy formulas are homogeneous under multiplying nu,eta,
Tau,omega by a common positive lambda: m,S,R,E are multiplied by
lambda while S/m and R/(kappa m) are unchanged. In particular, if
one constructs a flow at raw scale lambda and later divides all
surface laws by lambda, the error bound is

    E_raw(total)/lambda
       <=(m_raw/lambda)
              [1-exp(-d R_raw/(kappa m_raw))].            (12)

If only the endpoint dominations are gamma_-,gamma_+<=lambda omega,
apply the repair with reference lambda omega, i.e. with
numerator lambda H. The conclusion is D<=2^n lambda omega, while
(6) still uses the ACTUAL flow mass m and entropy S. Dividing laws
by lambda is an additional operation; no factor may silently be
removed from just one side of that inequality.

The common normal-reference choice also rescales conditional
masses and entropies by the same Radon--Nikodym factor. The budget
m[1-exp(-d Delta/m)] is degree one, so it integrates consistently.

## 7. What remains unproved by this bridge

For the actual full physical Xi, it remains necessary to exhibit a
common concave numerator H giving the required endpoint domination
and a useful total target-capacity payment. The algebraic density
Xi_- is not automatically of that form. The entropy term is now
identified exactly with an existing same-separator scalar, but an
additional correctly signed quantitative inequality is still needed
to spend that scalar toward the sharp OC constant.

## 8. Why unrestricted symmetric self-pairing is numerically trivial

In (1) the two endpoint marginals are identical: gamma_-=gamma_+=eta,
also after conditioning on normal and parity. The diagonal coupling
t_-=t_+ has midpoint law eta, lies on the actual support graph, and
has a=1. For every finite convex f, midpoint Jensen gives

    integral f drho_old
       <=(1/2) integral f d(gamma_-+gamma_+)=integral f deta.

Thus this diagonal coupling already supplies convex-order improvement
with ONE copy of omega, zero exact error, and no entropy expenditure
whenever eta<=omega. Reattaching sources uses the original physical
martingale itself. The generic symmetric construction therefore adds
no numerical constraint beyond the old convex order.

The nontrivial potential application of (3)-(10) must use prescribed
DISTINCT endpoint submarginals arising from the actual directional or
cap decomposition, together with their actual individual capacity
budgets. Its average endpoint law must be the relevant surface target
eta (or an explicitly accounted portion of it) for the same-separator
identity (9) to apply. No such distinct decomposition or capacity
payment is proved by the symmetric construction above.

## 9. Exact factor two in a proper binary subflow

A different commonly occurring representation must be normalized
separately. Suppose gamma_-,gamma_+ have common mass m_b, satisfy

    gamma_-+gamma_+<=eta,

and Tau_b is an actual paired law of them with midpoint rho_b. Assume
the actual source law is EXACTLY

    nu=eta-gamma_--gamma_++2rho_b.                        (13)

The residual eta-gamma_--gamma_+ is nonnegative and can stay on the
diagonal. The source branch 2rho_b sends equal probabilities to its
two paired endpoints, giving the remaining target gamma_-+gamma_+.
This constructs a physical martingale from nu to eta.

For this representation, the total surface entropy is

    S=integral log L(dnu-deta)=2 Delta_b,
    Delta_b=integral log L drho_b
                  -(1/2)integral log L d(gamma_-+gamma_+).

Applying repair directly to Tau_b with endpoint capacity omega gives

    E_b(total)<=m_b[1-exp(-d S/(2m_b))].                 (14)

The associated rebuilt source is
eta-gamma_--gamma_++2rho_b,new, and its error contribution is 2E_b.
Thus its error mass is at most

    2m_b[1-exp(-d S/(2m_b))].                           (15)

One may instead double Tau_b and its endpoint marginals to view this
as a flow of mass 2m_b, but then the endpoint capacity also doubles.
That operation cannot remove the factor two from (13)-(15).

Neither residual nonnegativity nor the exact source identity (13)
follows from an arbitrary physical martingale. They are extra data
that an actual binary cap/directional decomposition must establish.

## 10. Affine-weighted reserves on the actual surface martingale

Let q>0 be affine on C and F_q=q log(q/L), as in Section 10 of the
repair theorem. For an actual physical surface martingale row P_s,
write

    q_s=q(s)=integral q(t)P_s(dt),
    V_s=integral L(t)P_s(dt)<=L(s),
    Q_s(dt)=q(t)P_s(dt)/q_s,
    T_s(dt)=L(t)P_s(dt)/V_s.

Q_s and T_s are probability measures, with positive bounded densities
relative to P_s for the positive compact data here. Expanding their
relative entropy gives the EXACT row identity

    integral F_q(t)P_s(dt)-F_q(s)
       =q_s[log(L(s)/V_s)+KL(Q_s||T_s)].                 (16)

Thus the full surface convexity reserve

    S_q=integral F_q deta-integral F_q dnu>=0

has two nonnegative row contributions: concavity loss of L and
mismatch of the q-tilted and L-tilted target distributions. This is
not the inverse-volume row entropy from parameter stationarity.

For any prescribed paired decomposition satisfying Sections 3-4,
its old F_q Jensen gap obeys

    Delta_q,old
       =integral F_q deta-integral F_q drho_old
       <=S_q,

because the source-to-old-midpoint martingale gives
integral F_q drho_old>=integral F_q dnu. Affine q also gives the
fixed weighted mass

    T_q=integral q dnu=integral q drho_old=integral q deta.

The affine-weighted repair theorem consequently proves

    integral q dE
       <=T_q[1-exp(-d Delta_q,old/T_q)]
       <=T_q[1-exp(-d S_q/T_q)].                         (17)

Normal/parity assembly is homogeneous exactly as before. This is a
total actual-flow reserve statement; arbitrary sourcewise old/new
endpoint budgets remain unavailable after reconstruction.

In the same-separator setting nu-eta=Xi eta_surface, the actual
signed convex physical field kappa F_q has reserve

    R_q=-kappa integral Xi F_q deta_surface=kappa S_q.

It is an admissible finite convex test by the explicit global
extension in the repair theorem. Hence (17) can be expressed with
S_q=R_q/kappa, retaining that exact coefficient. This supplies a
family of affine-weighted actual surface reserves, but does not
turn their nonnegative signs into an equality or a cap probability
comparison. In particular q must remain affine; positive-part
localizations are not covered.
